responsibility: Runtime adapter for the original NeXT Objective-C ABIs 0 and 1, used by -fnext-runtime with older ABI versions. It installs ABI-specific objc_runtime_hooks for classic NeXT metadata layout, selector/class/protocol references, message-send entry points, constant strings, ivar access, and exception lowering, including the setjmp/longjmp-based Objective-C exception path used on Darwin for these ABIs, and emits the corresponding v1 runtime metadata structures and module records.
